replacements.before: Process traces show that most runs follow one planning--drafting--reviewing cycle, with departures used selectively rather than continually.
replacements.after: Process traces show that most runs follow a planning--drafting--reviewing path, with departures used selectively rather than continually.

replacements.instruction: Table 6 の 74.6% が repeat collapsing と leading-Planning reconstruction 後の process-path diagnostic であることを明示する
replacements.before: Table~\ref{tab:process-dynamics} shows a mostly simple writing loop: 74.6\% of traces follow Planning--Translating--Reviewing, while 14.8\% return from Review to Translating.
replacements.after: Table~\ref{tab:process-dynamics} shows a mostly simple writing loop after repeat collapsing and leading-Planning reconstruction: 74.6\% of complete paths conform to the Planning--Translating--Reviewing cycle structure, while 14.8\% of runs return from Review to Translating.

replacements.instruction: Conclusion でも normalized cycle-compliance を exact one-cycle と誤読させない
replacements.before: Across three long-form writing benchmarks, our system is preferred to single-pass generation, fixed writing stages, and adaptive task planning in same-prompt comparisons; neither explicit goals nor adaptive process ordering alone explains the advantage, and most traces follow one planning--drafting--reviewing cycle.
replacements.after: Across three long-form writing benchmarks, our system is preferred to single-pass generation, fixed writing stages, and adaptive task planning in same-prompt comparisons; neither explicit goals nor adaptive process ordering alone explains the advantage, and most traces follow a simple planning--drafting--reviewing path.
